# Release Readiness Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that release-readiness criteria are deterministic, evidence-based, and not bypassable
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Legend**: `[M]` mandatory (a constitution MUST, an approved requirement, or an approved decision); `[O]` optional enhancement or backlog boundary. `G0` is evaluable now against the approved specification, plan, ADRs, and contracts; `G1` is evaluable after `/speckit-tasks` and `/speckit-analyze`, before implementation. `{Detects: ...}` links an item to a failure pattern in the [README](README.md) detection matrix. Dimension tags: Completeness, Clarity, Consistency, Measurability, Coverage, Traceability, Edge Case, Assumption, Conflict, Gap.
## Determination

- [ ] CHK001 - Is release readiness a deterministic function of recorded state, with conditions C1..C5 enumerated? [Measurability, Spec FR-128, ADR-014] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is a blocking item defined for every unmet condition, listed by kind? [Completeness, Readiness contract] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is "a mandatory FAIL always blocks" defined with the only exception path and its limits? [Clarity, Spec DEC-096, DEC-108] [M, G0] {Detects: compliance-failure-not-blocking}
- [ ] CHK004 - Are non-waivable policies listed, with the outcome defined when one fails? [Coverage, ADR-014, Spec DEC-064] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the FR-128 and ASM-013 wording reconciled with the CONDITIONAL_PASS rule? [Conflict, Spec FR-128, ADR-014] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the tests-for-every-FR condition defined with the required evidence (executed, passing, not skipped)? [Measurability, Spec ASM-013, DEC-052] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are scan conditions defined (unresolved high or critical findings) with offline-scan treatment? [Coverage, Spec DEC-054, FR-127] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is audit chain verification a readiness condition? [Coverage, Compliance §4.1 C5] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are PVT results defined as reported but not gates, except PVT-014? [Clarity, Spec ASM-013, DEC-054] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is re-determination required after any upstream change? [Coverage, Spec FR-123] [M, G0]

## Declaration and Honesty

- [ ] CHK011 - Is the human declaration of readiness required, with an agent unable to declare it? [Coverage, Governance, POL-GOV-002] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is NOT_READY defined as a valid terminal outcome with an honest blocker list, and fabricating READY prohibited with a detection? [Clarity, Spec DEC-065, Constitution X] [M, G0] {Detects: unsupported-completion-claims}
- [ ] CHK013 - Are the ten Constitution XI completion criteria each mapped to a check or evidence item? [Traceability, Constitution XI, POL-DONE-001] [M, G0] {Detects: unsupported-completion-claims}
- [ ] CHK014 - Must residual risks and limitations be disclosed in the readiness report and final summary? [Coverage, Constitution XI] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are blocking demonstrations RB-1..5 defined with expected observable outputs? [Measurability, Compliance §4.2] [M, G0]

## Minimum Outcome and Checkpoints

- [ ] CHK016 - Is the minimum defensible outcome defined (gates exercised, scenario evidence, readiness function demonstrated, honest report)? [Completeness, Plan §6.5, Spec DEC-065] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are checkpoints CP-1..CP-6 defined with pass criteria, stop conditions, and a decision owner? [Completeness, Plan §6.4] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the outcome of a failed CP-1 precondition defined (stop with NOT_READY and a blocker list)? [Coverage, Spec DEC-069] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are performance smoke results labelled demonstration and reported as non-gating? [Clarity, Spec DEC-013] [O, G0]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items marked `[Gap]` or `[Conflict]` name a place where the current documents are silent or disagree; they are findings for the reviewer to resolve, not pre-judged results
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially within this file (`CHK001` onward); cite them as `<file>:CHKnnn`
